gloss: rising star; great hope; promising newcomer

definitions.gloss: rising star; the one everyone is counting on
definitions.explanation: A young or new person whom a team, company, or field expects great things from. Literally "star of expectation," and used most often in sports and entertainment reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}だ。
examples.english: She is the team's rising star.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He is drawing attention as a rising young star.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}した→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれていた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|おも}く→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{感|かん}じていた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧らしい。
examples.english: When he joined the company he was called the great hope, but apparently he found the phrase a heavy burden.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}: the team's rising star
- {期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to be called the great hope
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{球界|きゅうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}: the great hope of Japanese baseball

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ホープ: hope — the same idea borrowed from English, common in sports writing
- {有望株|ゆうぼうかぶ}: promising prospect — originally a stock-market term, slightly more businesslike
- {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: golden egg — a promising young recruit, especially a new graduate
